title: Bali Bucket List Holiday with Flights
alt: Kelingking beach seen from the cliff path, Nusa Penida
transport: Return flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Legian hotel with a rooftop pool, ten minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Water sports, Uluwatu and the Kecak dance
activities.description: Parasailing, jet ski and a banana boat at Tanjung Benoa, then Uluwatu temple at sunset and the Kecak fire dance in the amphitheatre.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west with snorkelling
activities.description: Speedboat across for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong and Broken Bay, with snorkelling and a local lunch included on the way back.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: An hour of traditional Balinese massage for both of you on your free day, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a spa in Kuta.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Four nights in Legian with water sports and Uluwatu, a full island day on Nusa Penida and a free day with a spa hour.

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Villa resort in the rice fields west of Ubud town

activities.name: Kintamani highlands tour
activities.description: The Mount Batur viewpoint, a coffee plantation tasting, Tegenungan waterfall and a turn on the jungle swing on the way up to Ubud.

activities.name: Tandem ATV ride
activities.description: Ninety minutes on a two seat quad bike through rice fields, a river crossing and a cave tunnel, with helmets and a guide ahead.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights in a rice field villa, reached through the Kintamani highlands, with a quad bike morning and a candlelight dinner.

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Flights, a free day, a quad bike morning and a candlelight dinner. It covers the whole Bali list without a rushed day.
expert.tip: Four nights in one hotel means you can move the Nusa Penida day if the sea looks rough. Ask us for the rooftop pool side in Legian and a garden villa in Ubud.

summary: Seven days with return flights: four nights in Legian for water sports, Uluwatu at sunset, Nusa Penida with snorkelling and a free spa day, then two nights in a rice field villa with a quad bike morning and a candlelight dinner.
included: Included: return flights from Delhi; 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; water sports with Uluwatu and the Kecak dance; Nusa Penida west coast tour with snorkelling and lunch; Balinese massage for two; Kintamani highlands tour; tandem ATV ride; candlelight dinner.
not_included: Not included: Indonesia visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
